title: Test Login OTP request and Verification

cues.en: In the last lecture we worked on the login routes.
cues.zh: 上一堂課完成了登入路由。

cues.en: Now what you can do is let's build our containers.
So you can go back to your terminal.
Then we can just say make, build.
Good.
Once our containers have been built in postman we're going to request for an OTP on the login route.
cues.zh: 容器建置好後，到 Postman 的登入路由申請 OTP。

cues.en: So you can go to postman.
Then you're going to request for an OTP by making a Post request to API dot localhost slash api slash v1 slash auth slash login, then slash request otp.
Then you're going to pass in the user's email and password.
cues.zh: 傳入使用者 email 與 password。

cues.en: Remember we had registered a user called MaryJane.
cues.zh: 記得，之前註冊了 Mary Jane。

cues.en: First what you're going to do.
We're going to log in as MaryJane but with the wrong password so that you can see if they failed attempts counter works.
cues.zh: 用 Mary Jane 登入，但故意提供錯誤密碼，測試失敗次數計數。

cues.en: So remember the password is pass 123456.
But you're going to supply pass 1234567.
Make the request good.
We get an error response saying invalid credentials.
cues.zh: 錯誤回應是「無效的認證資訊」。

cues.en: And you have two attempts remaining before the account is temporarily locked.
cues.zh: 帳戶被暫時鎖定前，還有兩次嘗試機會。

cues.en: So what you're going to do we're going to continue using the wrong password so that you can confirm that after three attempts our account is actually going to be locked.
cues.zh: 接著繼續使用錯誤密碼，確認三次後帳戶真的會鎖定。

cues.en: So we make the request again.
Good.
Invalid credentials.
You have one attempt remaining.
As you can see right there.
Then let's make the request again.
Request number three.
Good.
You're told that your account has been temporarily locked due to too many failed login attempts.
cues.zh: 訊息表示，登入失敗次數過多，帳戶已暫時鎖定。

cues.en: Please try again after two minutes.
Then we can confirm this on Table plus by going to let's say Table Plus.
cues.zh: 也可以到 TablePlus 確認。

cues.en: Then let me see.
Let me refresh.
Then click on user.
Then you're going to see on our user here that the account status right here is now locked.
cues.zh: 可以看到這位使用者的 account_status 已變成 locked。

cues.en: And if you scroll to the right again let's see.
You're going to see that you have the failed login attempts.
There were three.
And the last failed login attempt timestamp has also been recorded.
cues.zh: last_failed_login 的時間戳記也已記錄。

cues.en: So it means everything is working as expected.
So what you're going to do is we're going to wait for two minutes.
Then you're going to go back to postman, then make the request and hopefully this time with the correct password.
cues.zh: 再回 Postman，這次使用正確密碼，

cues.en: And we should see an email sent with the OTP.
cues.zh: 應該就會寄出 OTP 郵件。

cues.en: So let's give it some time.
So it's been two minutes.
So you can go back to postman and try to make the request again.
cues.zh: 回到 Postman，再發一次請求。

cues.en: And this time since two minutes has elapsed.
The request should work so you can go back to postman.
cues.zh: 請求應該成功，回到 Postman。

cues.en: Then you're going to send the same request again.
But this time make sure you add the correct password which is pass 123456, then send.
cues.zh: 但記得改成正確密碼 pass123456，再按 Send。

cues.en: Good.
You're going to get a 200 okay response status and are going to be told if an account exists with this email an OTP has been sent.
cues.zh: 得到 200 OK，訊息是「如果此郵件地址有對應帳戶，OTP 已寄出」。

cues.en: So you can confirm from Helpit go back to your browser.
cues.zh: 可以回到瀏覽器的 Mailpit 確認。

cues.en: Then on Marlpit you're going to see right here we have the login OTP.
cues.zh: 這裡有登入 OTP 郵件。

cues.en: Good.
The one time password is this and it's valid for two minutes.
cues.zh: 一次性密碼是這個，有效兩分鐘。

cues.en: So to verify this we need to make another request on postman.
cues.zh: 要驗證它，在 Postman 發出另一個請求。

cues.en: We're going to make another Post request to api localhost then slash api slash v1 slash auth slash login slash verify OTP with the user's email.
cues.zh: 用 POST 請求 api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/verify-otp，傳入使用者 email，

cues.en: Mine being Mary dot gin at gmail.com and then the OTP.
cues.zh: 我這裡是 mary.jane@gmail.com，再傳入 otp。

cues.en: Let's just get it.
It's 0025 70 back on postman 002570.
Make the request.
Okay, I'm told I failed to verify OTP.
I think I wasted too much time because the OTP expires after two minutes.
cues.zh: 可能花太多時間，因為 OTP 兩分鐘後到期。

cues.en: Okay, let me see.
Let's see what you can do.
Let's request OTP again.
Good.
Then let's go to help it.
Then let me copy this new OTP.
Come back to postman.
Add it in.
Okay I'm still getting the same error message.
So it means that the issue was not the time.
I think I'm still within time.
cues.zh: 我應該還在有效期間內。

cues.en: I think there's an error in the code.
So what you can do is let's go back to our IDE.
Then let's open our logs.
Let's open the error log and see if there are any error logs.
Okay.
As you can see here, failed to verify the OTP because there's an issue right here okay.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示無法驗證 OTP，因為有這個問題。

cues.en: Uh, unexpected keyword argument only.
cues.zh: 出現非預期的關鍵字引數，和 only 這個名稱有關。

cues.en: Okay.
Made a spelling mistake in our back end app API routes auth login and it's on line 120.
cues.zh: backend/app/api/routes/auth/login.py 的第 120 行，好像有拼字錯誤。

cues.en: So you can go back to the login profile in backend app API routes auth.
Then let's see line 120 right there.
Okay.
The exception is raised here because I made a mistake.
cues.zh: 例外在這裡拋出，因為有個錯誤。

cues.en: Let me see okay.
It's not on that file.
So I think I made the mistake in the configuration.
cues.zh: 可能是在設定裡弄錯了。

cues.en: Let me see.
Let me just search for that error which is ADT eight only.
cues.zh: 先搜尋錯誤裡那個 only 參數名稱。

cues.en: Aha.
Okay.
As you can see in my utils, I made the mistake right here.
Instead of HTTP only, I said HTTP only.
cues.zh: HttpOnly 參數的拼字寫錯了。

cues.en: That's supposed to be HTTP.
You can save that file.
Then I think now we should be good to go.
Sorry for that mistake, but at least you've seen how I debug.
cues.zh: 抱歉打錯，不過至少示範了如何除錯。

cues.en: And our errors have played a very important role in helping us with our debugging efforts.
cues.zh: 錯誤日誌對除錯很有幫助。

cues.en: So what you can do is let's go back to postman, then let's try logging in again so that you can get a new OTP.
cues.zh: 回到 Postman，重新登入，取得新的 OTP。

cues.en: Good.
Let's go back to Mail Pit.
We have the OTP.
We can copy this, then go back to postman to verify the OTP.
cues.zh: 複製，再回 Postman 驗證。

cues.en: Paste it right there.
Make the request good.
And as you can see, we get a 200 response status code and we're told login successful.
cues.zh: 得到 200 回應，訊息是「登入成功」。

cues.en: And we get the user object with some values.
cues.zh: 也取得包含部分欄位的 user 物件。

cues.en: And the most important thing is now if you go to this cookies tab you're going to see that we have the three cookies.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，Cookies 分頁現在有三個 Cookie。

cues.en: We have the access token, the refresh token and the login token.
cues.zh: 存取權杖、更新權杖，以及登入狀態 Cookie。

cues.en: The access and the login cookie are going to have the same expiry time as you can see right there.
cues.zh: 存取與登入狀態 Cookie 的到期時間相同。

cues.en: Look at that timestamp.
They expire the same time and the refresh token expires one day later.
cues.zh: 兩者同時到期，更新權杖 Cookie 則晚一天到期。

cues.en: Then you're also going to realize that the logged in cookie doesn't have any sensitive information.
cues.zh: 也會看到，logged_in Cookie 不包含敏感資訊。

cues.en: So if you see here within value, the access token and the refresh token have some token values.
cues.zh: Value 這裡，存取與更新權杖都有權杖值。

cues.en: But the login cookie just has the value of true.
cues.zh: 但登入狀態 Cookie 只有 true。

cues.en: And this logged in cookie is going to help a lot with front end authorization if we're ever to build a front end.
cues.zh: 如果之後建立前端，它會協助判斷前端登入狀態。

cues.en: That's why the logged in cookie doesn't have the HTTP only field set to true.
cues.zh: 所以 logged_in 的 httponly 並沒有設為 True。

cues.en: It's false because it doesn't have any sensitive information, just the value of true.
cues.zh: 而是 False，因為沒有敏感資訊，只有 true。

cues.en: So I hope this now makes sense.
And with that being said we're going to go back to VS code.
Then we're going to make a commit.
So now git client we're going to say this is a feature.
cues.zh: 到 Git 用戶端，類型是 feat。

cues.en: And you can say user can request OTP login and get auth cookies like that.
cues.zh: 訊息寫 user can request OTP login and get auth cookies。

cues.en: Then you can make the commit.
And that's it for this lecture.
In the next lecture we're going to be working on some other email templates.
cues.zh: 下一堂課處理其他郵件範本。
